messages:
maria_devex: Anyone else seeing the ruby-sampleapp CI hang on macOS runners? Looks like bundler gets stuck during `bundle install` and the test job times out. Repro locally on macOS 12.6 VM.

sam_engineer: I hit that yesterday. In my case the process was waiting on the system prompt for `gem install` for native extensions. CI doesn't allocate a TTY so it just waits.

oliver_maint: Could be the platform gem requiring Xcode CLT. The Docker linux runners skipped it. What's the failing log?

maria_devex: Snippet:
```
Fetching nokogiri-1.14.10
Building native extensions. This could take a while...
ERROR: Failed to build gem native extension.
```
But the job didn't error, it just hung at 'Building native extensions' for 40m.

chris_ci: :eyes: CI log shows `bundle config set jobs 1` isn't being picked up, so parallel build spawns >4 processes, macos runner kills some and prompts. Could be our sampleapp's `.bundle/config` not checked in.

sam_engineer: We used to run `bundle config set --local build.nokogiri --use-system-libraries` in workflow. Seems gone after the recent dkms patch.

maria_devex: Two asks: 1) quick triage fix for sampleapp so onboarding works for mac users; 2) while digging I noticed our Ruby SDK lacks the 'max_concurrency' config that Go/TS SDKs have for stream/batch callers — can we sync that in a small PR?

oliver_maint: For 1) quick workaround: add in .github/workflows/ci.yml step before `bundle install`:
```
- run: |
    bundle config set --local jobs 1
    bundle config set --local build.nokogiri --use-system-libraries
```
That should avoid interactive prompts.

sam_engineer: For 2) agreed. We have a similar param `concurrency_limit` but it's not exposed in the public initializer. PR incoming to expose as `max_concurrency` alias and wire through to the batcher. Will open draft.

maria_devex: Thanks! Can someone review the draft PR? It's tiny but touches the client constructor and docs.

chris_ci: I can review tomorrow. FYI the sampleapp README should also mention macOS pre-reqs (Xcode CLT) to reduce onboarding friction.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: ci/samples-ruby #42 finished with warnings.

maria_devex: :thumbsup: I'll add the ci step and update README in the same PR, + link to PR when ready.
